# Meme Lab

> Paste a comment and get the meme that fits it best.

Site: https://memes.significanthobbies.com

## Pages

- `/` — paste a comment, get the best-matching meme
- `/collection.html` — browse the meme catalogue
- `/how-it-works.html` — how recommendations are made

## How it works

A Cloudflare Worker serves a static app backed by a Vectorize index of
catalogued memes (BGE embeddings) plus a D1 feedback store. Recommendations
expire and are pruned by a daily scheduled job.

Maintained by Sarthak Agrawal: https://sarthakagrawal.dev
